reason: A1 specified the control as the same keys and rows in a LATE band, 'differing ONLY in the layer band'. The ko arm's liveness record shows that is not quite true: median_prefill_edits = 513 = 57 demonstration key positions x 9 layers (6-14). A 20-31 control spans 12 layers and would edit 57 x 12 = 684 cells -- 33 percent MORE than the intervention it controls for. The direction is conservative (a larger control makes a positive ko-minus-ctrl harder to obtain), but 'differing only in the band' would have been false as written, and an asymmetric control is how this experiment already went wrong once.
